header.about: Quicksilver's stab energy and opening round. kind opener: [stab energy, normal blows after the stab] for one normal blow costing `normal` energy, from the engine's backstab_energy and energy round (the round's blow limit counts the stab). kind energy: [normal blow energy, stab energy] from the engine's fighter builder for a player (Strength 50, a 1-4 weapon of the given speed, no strength requirement); combat is the class value MME uses (the class's CombatLVL less 2). v120 is the 1.20.0 balance, neutral has a stab that costs 1000 times a normal blow (so it fills the round), alt is an off-grid balance (see balance_keys).
